greet: Hello! I am Fasal Saathi. Ask me about the latest scan, diseases, soil moisture, temperature, how many plants were checked, or what to do. I can also take a photo for you.
no_scans_count: No photos have been checked yet.
no_scans: There are no scan results yet. Please take a photo of a leaf first.
latest_not_plant: The last photo had no plant leaf in it.
disease_none: No disease found in the checked plants so far.
count: {n} photos checked so far: {h} healthy, {d} with disease, {r} need a second look.
soil_none: I have no soil moisture reading right now. The soil sensor is not sending data.
weather_value: Temperature is {t} degrees Celsius and humidity is {h} percent.
weather_none: I have no temperature reading right now. The sensor is not sending data.
where: The place of every scan is saved. You can see it on the map in the dashboard.
unknown: You can ask: latest scan, any disease, soil moisture, temperature, how many plants, or what to do.
pump_on: Okay, running the pump for 3 seconds.
no_model: Photo saved. The disease model is not installed yet.
not_plant: I cannot see a plant leaf in this photo. Please take a clear, close photo of one leaf in good light.
review: I am not sure about this result. Please check the plant by eye or take a clearer photo.
soil_dry: The soil is dry. Water the plant.
soil_wet: The soil is very wet. Do not water now and check that water can drain.
adv_healthy: The leaf looks healthy. No treatment is needed. Keep regular watering and checking.
adv_fungal: This is probably a fungal disease. Remove badly affected leaves and dispose of them safely, avoid watering from above, improve air flow between plants, and ask your local agriculture officer which medicine and how much to use.
adv_bacterial: This is probably a bacterial disease. Remove affected leaves, do not touch healthy plants after touching sick ones, avoid watering from above, and ask your local agriculture officer for a suitable treatment.
adv_viral: This is probably a virus disease. Virus diseases cannot be cured. Remove and destroy the infected plant if there are only a few, control insects like whiteflies and aphids that spread it, and ask your local agriculture officer.
adv_pest: This looks like mite damage. Check the underside of the leaves, spray the plant with a strong stream of water, and ask your local agriculture officer for a suitable treatment.
